items.hook: Albigensian Crusade: The Cathar stronghold of Carcassonne falls to the crusaders.
items.body: The Albigensian Crusade, also known as the Cathar Crusade (1209–1229), was a military and ideological campaign initiated by Pope Innocent III to eliminate Catharism in Languedoc, what is now southern France. The world is stranger than it lets on.
